subject: Private deployment demo — VPC onboarding and security preflight
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Zhang <olivia@healthcore.com>
Date: 2026-08-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick intro + private deployment demo slots

Hi Olivia —

Thanks for signing up and for the note in the self-serve flow. I can see you selected Private (VPC) for evaluation — great choice for regulated workloads. I work on new accounts in healthcare and will coordinate a short technical demo and network preflight with our solutions engineer.

High level ask: could you confirm two 45-minute windows next week when your security/network lead could join? We typically cover architecture, networking requirements (subnet/egress), and a demo of our private control plane + on-prem agent.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue 8/18: 10:00–10:45 or 15:00–15:45
- Wed 8/19: 09:30–10:15 or 14:00–14:45

I cc'd Marissa (solutions) so she can tailor the agenda. I also attached our "network-preflight-checklist.xlsx" and a one-pager SOC2 summary so your security team can triage ahead of time.

Quick next steps:
- Reply with preferred slot + who from your side will be on the call (security/network names)
- If you prefer, here's a calendar link to pick: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/d/3456-demo-slot

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Cheers,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Mobile: (415) 555-0217

- Wed 8/19 at 14:00 PT (preferred)

Perfect — locking Wed 8/19 14:00 PT for now. Marissa (solutions engineer) will lead the walkthrough and Rishi (platform PM) can join for the architecture/Q&A.

Attached: demo-agenda.pdf (45-minute plan), SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted controls), network-preflight-checklist.xlsx (what we need from your infra team).

Agenda highlights:

Mutual action items (map):
- HealthCore: confirm attendees (security + network), provide sample firewall rules if available
- Redwood: demo recording + tailored network checklist filled out after call

If anything changes you can reply here or use the calendar link: https://calendar.redwoodinference.com/d/3456-demo-slot

Thanks — we’ll send an invite in a minute.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
